messages:
Lucia M.: Canary finished for priority-aware-packer (10% traffic, 6h). Summary: p95 down ~20% for customer-chat workloads, p99 down ~17%, token cost estimated -13%. No customer errors seen. Plan to promote if no flags.

perf-bot: ```
CANARY: priority-aware-packer-1967890000
workloads: customer-chat (avg seq 340), background-embed (avg seq 160)
baseline: p50=52ms p95=210ms p99=480ms cost=$13.6/1M tokens
canary:   p50=47ms p95=168ms p99=398ms cost=$11.8/1M tokens
delta:    p95 -20% p99 -17% cost -13%
notes: improvements concentrated on small/latency-sensitive reqs; fallback engaged sporadically in high mem pressure windows
```

Devon T.: Nice work. Any regressions on long-running streams or chat sessions with many turns?

Lucia M.: We ran extended-turn subset (avg turns=22, seq avg 3.8k) and saw negligible change: p99 +6ms vs baseline. We added rule: do not pack across active-stream sessions and cap pack_tokens_per_request=4096. Config snippet: 

```yaml
priority_aware_packer:
  enabled: true
  time_window_ms: 14
  max_pack_tokens: 4096
  exclude_streaming_sessions: true
  priority_buckets: ["latency", "throughput"]
  metrics_tag: ["pap_canary"]
```

Kai Z.: Observability: eu-central-1 had a brief spike in pack fallback at 02:11 UTC correlated with a host-side memory cleanup job triggered by the infra daemon. ops-bot removed the host from rotation for 90s. No customer impact recorded. Link: https://console/perf/1967890000

ops-bot: remediation: host i-0f12ab removed at 2026-04-05T02:11:45Z due to memcleanup, replaced in 1m5s.

Devon T.: Can we get a breakdown of pack sizes and the priority bucket distribution on the dashboard? Want to confirm latency bucket gets consistent wins.

perf-bot: ```
DASHBOARD SAMPLE
- packed_batch_size: mean=3.2 median=3 p95=8
- pack_by_priority: latency=62% throughput=38%
- fallback_rate: 0.6%
- estimated_cost_saving: 12.9%
```

Lucia M.: Filed GH #2782 to add priority split and per-region histograms. Rollout plan: bump to 30% in 24h, 60% in 48h. Auto-rollback if fallback_rate > 2% sustained over 5m or cache_timeouts > 2% in 1m.

Kai Z.: LGTM. I'll watch alerts for the next 48h and check nightly drift runs.

Lucia M.: Thanks all 680. Will post the rollout PR shortly and attach the detailed traces and flamegraphs.
